description: This source file defines the ResumeSource class, which provides sophisticated Akka Streams components for creating fault-tolerant, resumable data streams with backoff and failure recovery mechanisms. It includes methods for building sources that can resume from previous state after errors, with exponential backoff, look-behind buffers, and support for failure handling and seed management.

classes.name: ResumeSource
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to create fault-tolerant Akka Streams sources with resumption capabilities, exponential backoff, and failure handling logic. It includes nested classes for internal state management such as envelopes, backoff strategies, and look-behind buffers.

classes.name: Envelope
classes.description: An internal marker interface for stream elements, errors, and completion signals used within the resume logic.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents a stream element within the internal envelope, encapsulating the actual data item.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Represents an error signal in the internal envelope, wrapping a Throwable.

classes.name: EndOfStream
classes.description: Signals the end of a stream within the internal envelope.

classes.name: FailureWithLookBehind
classes.description: Holds the final elements seen before a failure and the associated Throwable for context in failures.

classes.name: NeverCancelFlow
classes.description: An Akka GraphStage flow component that never cancels upstream, used to maintain feedback loops.

classes.name: EndStreamOnEOS
classes.description: A flow that terminates the downstream when an EndOfStream marker is encountered.

classes.name: StatefulBackoffFunction
classes.description: Implements exponential backoff for error streams, managing delay durations based on recent errors.

classes.name: StatefulLookBehindFunction
classes.description: Maintains a fixed-size buffer of recent elements to provide look-behind data for failed streams.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for configuring a ResumeSource.

methods.name: onFailureWithBackoff
methods.description: Constructs a fault-tolerant Source that resumes after failures with exponential backoff, seed updates, and look-behind support.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Internal method that assembles the Akka Streams source components based on the builder's configuration.

methods.name: resumeWithFailuresAppended
methods.description: Creates a Flow that produces elements or failure signals, maintaining a look-behind buffer of recent elements for context on failures.
